title: Cabuck
description: As the owner and barkeep of the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop, Cabuck often brought his son, Cabuck Junior, to work to keep the noodles flowing for the denizens of Ueda. When a mysterious woman arrived and killed Jedi Master Indara and almost killed him, Cabuck didn't have much of a choice but to mistakenly identify Osha Aniseya as the perpetrator of the crime.
